title: Tress of the Emerald Sea
summary: On the oceanic world of Lumar, where twelve distinct types of spore seas—each with dangerous magical properties—cover the planet, a young woman named Tress lives a simple life as a cupwasher on a remote island. When her love Charlie is kidnapped and taken to the Sorceress of the Midnight Sea, Tress embarks on a daring journey across the spore seas, crewed by a motley band of thieves, dragons, and a talking rat. Narrated by Hoid with his characteristic wit and digressions, Tress discovers that courage comes in many forms and that the most unlikely people can become heroes. This standalone adventure explores themes of love, adventure, and the power of determination in a world where even the oceans are alive with danger.
archiveDescription: This unusual accession documents a journey across the spore seas of Lumar, a world where oceanic investiture manifests in twelve distinct types of hazardous spores. The record is framed by the commentary of a narrator whose identity and nature are themselves subjects of scholarly interest. The volume follows a young woman's transformation from an ordinary cupwasher to a captain and explorer, navigating both physical dangers and the complexities of a world where the oceans themselves are alive with latent power. This accession is classified as exceptional due to the narrative's unique framing and the light it sheds on the broader Cosmere's more obscure regions.
